newsitem.title: USA: Dresser's Wellstream sets UK plant.
newsitem.headline: Dresser's Wellstream sets UK plant.

text.p: Wellstream said Tuesday it will establish its first European flexible pipe manufacturing plant at Walker Riverside in Newcastle-upon-Tyne, England.

The Dresser Industries Inc division said construction will start immediately and the plant will be in commercial operation by January 1998, more than doubling Wellstream's present capacity at its Panama City facility.
Phase I of the development is designed to manufacture flexible pipe of up to 17-inch internal diameter.

Handling and storage systems will result in the ability to produce significantly longer flowlines than presently possible. This capability will capture cost advantages offered by the increasing number of new generation high-capacity lay vessels.

The covered facility of 22,500 square meters and open storage area of 34,200 square meters are located adjacent to a heavy loadout quay equipped with permanent cranage capable of handling loads up to 300 metric tonnes and accommodating vessels of up to nine-meter draft.
